entries.land_description: Our dream is to be part of a network of SAFE SPACES for wimmin. Right now we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond. We provide almost all our own food with three large gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees (to be planted this spring). We support the land partly by working outside jobs and partly by holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer. We are working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites.
entries.notes: (Susun Weed & Clove). We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, wimmin living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: (Between Ithaca & Watkins Glen, NY.) North-woods is in its 6th year as womyn's land, now moving this spring to a more focused use of the land than just gardening and living. We're investing in farm equipment and need work energy. Healing is a focus of many of us.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously), girl children
entries.notes: We need everyone here to be self sufficient and self motivated. We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: We are building a womyn's homestead on 25 acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV. Secluded land, access by foot or 4-wheel drive. We are carpenters and woodworker/blacksmith as well as farmers. Will teach skills to serious apprentices.
entries.notes: Visitors welcome and expected to help (bring own food). We have/are: 2 lesbians, 25 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: We are a collective of seven wimmin dedicated to caring for 40 acres and each other. We strive to tolerate our differences as well as enjoy them. We are striving toward self sufficiency.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (but only on leash)
entries.notes: Visits require work exchange and/or cash for short stays. Longer visits/meals negotiable. Have communal kitchen. We are not separatists. We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political, but most important we are loving wimmin trying to give each other space to grow! We have/are: 7 lesbians, 40 acres, permanent structures (in process), outdoor plumbing, electricity (also hook-ups for couple of RV's), camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land. We are developing a self sufficient space 35 miles SE of Austin, that will provide most of our food and bring in at least part of our survival money. Our plans include chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard, and a stain-glass and spinning workshop.
entries.notes: Visits limited to 2-3 days, $2 per person or work exchange, no drugs, alcohol or cigarrettes please. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 18 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity, camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.street_address: c/o Linda or Sara, PO Box 274
entries.land_description: We are a couple in our 40's, vegies/non-smokers, living on 13 acres, deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'. Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members, very hard to make a living locally, rural, quite isolated, wet winters, hot summers, near incredible Yuba River, other parcels for sale nearby and looking for lesbian buyers.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: We have/are: 2 lesbians, 13 acres, trailer, shed, electricity/well, camping space, woods, organic garden/ orchard, women living and working on the land.
